project.name: Frontmend
project.summary: Frontmend turns live site evidence into an agent-guided browser and repository repair loop with human authority and exact fresh verification.
project.ai_usage: Twenty-one contextual WebMCP tools let a compatible coding agent carry a bounded mission through public measurement, exact rendered-browser checks, repository-aware diagnosis, authorised repair, and post-deployment replay while the page preserves evidence and human authority.
project.codex_usage: Codex helped scope, implement, test, release-harden, and document the product, and is the repository-aware agent used in the primary workflow.
